Container.Name: Savorum
Container.Overview:
Savorum is a free, open-source recipe manager that keeps your cookbook on your own server. Save recipes from public websites, scan them from PDFs and photographs, import your collection from Paprika, Mealie, Tandoor Recipes, or CookBook Manager, and review each import before saving it.
Search recipes and ingredients, mark favourites, and organize your collection into books with covers and chapters. A recipe can belong to several books without making extra copies. Scale supported ingredient quantities for the batch you need, then follow cooking mode one step at a time with ingredient check-offs and timers. Several dishes can stay in progress together.
Plan recipes, simple dishes, and leftovers for the week. Add ingredients from the plan to a shopping list, with pantry notes to help check what you already have. Print full-page recipes or kitchen recipe cards, and export recipes with their photographs in SREF, an open recipe format.
Use the web interface on a phone, tablet, or computer. Start with a local library or enable accounts and shared libraries for your household. Savorum runs in one container, with the database and recipe files kept together in appdata.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: recipes cookbook cooking meal planner shopping pantry
Container.Requires: Before the first start, create the appdata folder with owner 65532:65532 and mode 0700. Enter the address you will use to open Savorum in the Savorum address field. The README has the setup commands. The default local library has no sign-in; keep it on a trusted private network until accounts and secure remote access are configured.

Config.Name: Web interface port
Config.Description: Choose a free port on your Unraid server. Use the same port in Savorum address. The container port stays at 8080.

Config.Name: Recipe library
Config.Description: A dedicated folder for your recipes, photographs, and library settings. Before starting, create it with owner 65532:65532 and mode 0700; see the README. Keep this folder when reinstalling the container.

Config.Name: Savorum address
Config.Description: The exact address you will use in your browser, for example http://192.168.1.10:8080. Include the chosen host port; omit a path or trailing slash. For a reverse proxy, enter its HTTPS address.

Config.Name: Network discovery
Config.Description: Leave false with the template's bridge network. Connect browsers and clients using Savorum address.
